_meta.note: Extracted byte-identical from StarPolicy.cs (tunables-ssot.md M.4, 2026-08-23). SacrificesForStar's 1..5 bound and StarCap's rarity->cap shape stay structural (the star system's own range), only the numbers a balance pass would tune moved. Widened 2026-09-01 (seed-to-concrete T4.1, owner Q4/Q24) from the old four-value CreatureRarity to the ten-rung ladder — starCap/recipeCost/slotsByRarity are starting values, staircase-interpolated from the old four points, not a validated balance decision (ssot-power-scale.md §5.3's own precedent for 'pick numbers now, tune from play'). recipeCost now covers Cultivated..Almanac (7 rungs) matching CreatureRecipeCatalog.OutputEligibilityFloor, not the old rare/epic/legendary (3 rungs) — the eligibility floor is the one source of truth, read at load time. Corrected 2026-09-01 (same day, caught by FusionE2ETests.Legendary_chain_from_commons): the initial staircase-interpolation set every recipeCost.shardRarity to the LITERAL one-rung-below id (e.g. cultivated->grafted), but today's catalog only populates Chaff/Cultivated/Heirloom/Sunwoven — nobody ever holds a shard.grafted/fused/chimeric/firstseed. shardRarity now names the nearest POPULATED rung below, matching CreatureRecipeCatalog.InputPoolBelow's own walk-down search exactly (cultivated/fused/chimeric/heirloom -> chaff or cultivated; firstseed/sunwoven -> heirloom; almanac -> sunwoven, still literal since Sunwoven is populated).
_meta.noteStars2026_09_05: Owner decision 2026-09-05, from the effort-power reconciliation. (a) MaxStar 5 -> 10; starCap doubled per rung (3->6, 4->8, 5->10), preserving the existing rarity shape exactly. (b) The per-star REWARD is now indexed on the triangular sacrifice cost instead of being flat per star -- cumulative sacrifices are n(n+3)/2 while the reward was perStar*n, so reward-per-sacrifice was 60/(n+3) and star 5 was an exactly 2x worse deal than star 1. StarPolicy.StarPowerMilli anchors the curve at star 5, so no creature at or below the old cap changes value. perStarPowerMilli/perStarDefenseMilli are now the ANCHOR at star 5, not a flat per-star rate. (c) promotionCostByRarity replaces the flat 200 souls, shaped like recipeCost's own 150->1000 escalation; the flat promotionCost row stays as the fallback for a rung the table does not name.
